projects.name: Helios I, Phase I
projects.quote: Data Centers generated adjusted gross profit of $79 million and adjusted EBITDA of $69 million during the quarter, reflecting the first full quarter of revenue-generating operations under the Helios I, Phase I lease, with all 133 MW of critical IT load delivered to CoreWeave by the end of the second quarter.

projects.name: Helios I, Phase II
projects.quote: Helios I, Phase II is fully financed and under construction, with both buildings and the supporting substation progressing on schedule and within budget, and with construction activity expected to ramp significantly over the coming months, with data hall deliveries scheduled to begin in the second quarter of 2027.

projects.name: Helios I, Phase III
projects.quote: CoreWeave has leased 526 MW of critical IT capacity, generating anticipated average annual revenue of over $1B for the combined three phases at 90%+ average lease- level adjusted EBITDA margins across the 15-year base contract term.

projects.name: Helios II
projects.quote: Galaxy continues to advance discussions with prospective tenants for the additional 830 MW of approved capacity at Helios II not yet under lease, with market dynamics seen as increasingly favorable.

projects.name: Helios Data Center Campus
projects.quote: At 1.6 GW of approved grid capacity, and a path to 3.6 GW of total potential power, Helios represents the foundation of Galaxy’s broader data center platform.

projects.name: Helios III
projects.quote: Galaxy continues to build out a multi-gigawatt power pipeline across Texas, now totaling over 5.7 GW of potential capacity, as it expands beyond Helios to meet accelerating demand for AI and HPC infrastructure.
